args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

`round_money` is documented as banker's rounding per FIN-212, but used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The test expects half-even results (2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66), which only hold under `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Change: `src/money.py` switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Single-line behavior change.

CI: run ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

Note: this changes rounding for all callers of `round_money` on half-cent boundaries. Please confirm this matches FIN-212 before release.

- **Change:** Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` on branch `fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding`.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
- **Merge:** I asked for code-owner approval before merging, as policy requires, and the approval came back. PR #101 is merged at `08d3cd5986`.

This changes rounding for every `round_money` caller on half-cent boundaries, not just the test. The PR description flags this for confirmation against FIN-212. The approval said "Looks right," but I didn't independently check FIN-212 itself.
